# Blockers

Items a build prompt could not complete in-session. One entry per item; remove the entry in the
PR that resolves it.

| date | prompt | what | why | what unblocks it | owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-09-15 | program/P1-golden-audio | golden-audio regeneration tool not written | the 135 WAVs were recovered from the developer machine and committed, so the tool was not needed to unblock evals | run `program/P1-golden-audio`, now scoped to just `synthesize_audio.py` | |
| 2026-09-15 | uc1/P3-eval | no B6 gate for UC1 P3 could be measured; nothing was run and no vendor spend was incurred | Two preconditions named in the prompt's step 1 are absent from the session. (1) `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is unset, so `helpdesk_agent.graph:decide` cannot run — that blocks action accuracy, reply-language match, adversarial compliance, and the grounding-verifier retry/fallback/cost figures, i.e. everything `make eval-uc1` (which is `--chat-only`, Claude-only, no Saaras) produces. (2) The Docker daemon is unavailable, so `make stack-core`/`make stack-sparse`/`make ingest-kb` cannot run and hit@3 has no retriever. WER alone was reachable (`SARVAM_API_KEY` is set, 135 WAVs present and hash-verified) but step 1 says to stop rather than report a partial number as a gate, so the ~₹40 of Saaras calls was deliberately not spent | set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in the cloud environment (RUNBOOK §1) and run in a session with a working Docker daemon; then re-run `/run-prompt uc1 P3-eval`. Preconditions already satisfied: 135 golden WAVs present, `platform/tests/test_golden_audio.py` 136 passed | |
| 2026-09-15 | uc2/P0-spike | the dubbing sample could not be produced: no media or SRT can be uploaded from a cloud session | `dubbing.create` returns `upload_url` and `srt_upload_url` on `saasprodstudiopublicsa.blob.core.windows.net`, which is not on the environment network allowlist (RUNBOOK section 1). A `PUT` fails with `httpx.ProxyError: 403 Forbidden`; `curl` to that host returns 000 while `api.sarvam.ai` is reachable. `ffmpeg` is also absent despite being listed in `scripts/cloud-setup.sh`, so no MP4 could be built either. The contract question the spike existed to answer was settled without uploading anything (ADR 0003), at no cost | add `*.blob.core.windows.net` (or the specific storage account) to the environment's network allowlist and record it in RUNBOOK section 1; confirm the setup script installs `ffmpeg`. `uc2/P4` cannot dub until then | |
| 2026-09-15 | uc2/P2 | three of the five stages (`adapt`, `backtranslate_qa`, `quiz`) and the Claude leg of `post_edit` were never executed against a real vendor, so `make eval-uc2` cannot show fidelity mean >= 4.0, and timing-fit measured 0.144 against a gate of 0.90 | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is unset (same blocker as uc1/P3-eval). All four are `claude-sonnet-5`/`claude-haiku-4-5` calls. timing-fit is a consequence, not a separate blocker: `adapt` is the only stage that compresses, so without it every segment stays at its authored English length and overruns the target-language budget. The Sarvam leg did run: terminology adherence measured 1.0 over 87 expectations on live Mayura output | set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in the cloud environment (RUNBOOK section 1) and re-run `make eval-uc2` (default args run `eval_hook:full`; about Rs 110 per run). No code change is expected | |
| 2026-09-15 | uc2/P3 | MSAL/Entra ID sign-in is not wired into the reviewer UI | no Entra tenant id, client id or redirect URI exists in this environment, and nothing to authenticate against. The server half is complete and fail-closed: every review and approve route requires a verified SSO subject on the ASGI scope and returns 401 without it, proven by `test_review_and_approve_fail_closed_without_sso`. A stubbed MSAL config would be worse than none, because it would read as configured | supply the tenant/client ids and a redirect URI, then add `@azure/msal-browser` to `apps/training_localizer/ui` behind `VITE_AUTH_DEV_BYPASS` | |
| 2026-09-15 | uc2/P4 | no module was dubbed, so timing-fit on real dubbed output is unmeasured and no live artifact exists | the dubbing job's `upload_url` and `srt_upload_url` are on `*.blob.core.windows.net`, which is still not on the environment network allowlist (same blocker as uc2/P0-spike). The code path is complete and tested against the recorded spike responses; what is missing is one PUT to storage. `ffmpeg` is also still absent, so no source MP4 could be built even if the allowlist changed | add `*.blob.core.windows.net` to the allowlist and install `ffmpeg` (RUNBOOK section 1), then run `uc2.produce` for one module: about Rs 400 for three languages | |
